answer: Make every agent burn 200 POA to enter a public identity registry before it can vote, and publish the burn receipt next to its handle. Peers check the registry before counting any vote, reject unlisted identities outright, and flag any second handle tied to the same burn proof for removal. Forging 1,000 voters then costs 200,000 POA burned for good, plus 1,000 receipts to fake, and each fake dies the moment its receipt fails the registry check. It works like a cipher carved on a wharf piling above a lagoon, plain for all to see and worthless once copied.
